# Clip 1.3.9
Clip 1.3.9 brings Live Share much closer to source-display quality in both the web and app viewers.
## Live Share quality
- Preserve the captured pixel dimensions through WebRTC instead of introducing point-versus-pixel scaling that softened text and UI edges. - Render app-to-app shares at exact backing-pixel scale when they fit, with crisp integral scaling when the viewer window is resized. - Seed new peer connections from the selected quality bandwidth so screen content stays sharper during scrolling and other high-motion updates. - Expand stream diagnostics with source, capture, manifest, encoded-dimension, bitrate, QP, encode-time, and send-queue details.
## Color
- Carry Native Display color metadata through Clip's reviewed WebRTC build and apply it in the native Metal viewer. - Keep compatible Rec.709 fallbacks for streams or displays that do not provide usable native color metadata. - Update the web viewer protocol so browser and app viewers use the same source geometry and color contract.
## Requirements
Clip requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon. This build uses the same stable Apple Development identity as previous updater releases.
